emit_policy.comment: Episodes anchor on the egocentric RGB video. Emit an episode only when video AND gaze AND at least one annotation channel resolve. A missing optional piece prints a warning and is skipped; it never aborts the run.

metadata.comment: The manifest step computes per-episode metadata on a host where these tools exist (bare L40S lacks them). Shipped metadata is trusted where a dataset provides it (see each recipe's metadata.prefer_shipped).
